findings.body: The supplied proof list is missing, and the latest worker commit contains no `Proof list:` paragraph. The detailed list in an older commit does not satisfy the current-round requirement: src/forge/review.py:401–407 deliberately reads only the latest non-bookkeeping worker commit. Restore the complete item-to-proof mapping in the latest commit, including the updated machine-view checks.

findings.body: The machine-view proof checks only that `load` exists and that memory values are null or nonnegative integers. Replacing machine.load with a constant all-null dictionary would pass every assertion here; the other changed snapshot tests explicitly exclude these measurements. Done-when 4 requires OS-derived measurements, so extend the command-level proof to fail when available OS measurements are omitted or replaced with placeholders.
findings.title: Not done: machine load and memory come from the OS

findings.body: This previous gap remains open. Admission snapshots `chosen`, but Autoreview defaults and fallback update only `selected` and activity progress at review.py:603–611. The worker fallback similarly replaces `chosen` at worker.py:165 without updating its entry. Both reader paths join using repo.models at story.py:222 and :230; repo.py:411–419 returns an empty selection when unconfigured, and subsequent selection events at repo.py:278–283 and codex.py:384–386 update only activity records. Board lanes therefore retain null or obsolete model/effort values during actual runs. Refresh the shared entry across these selection paths.
findings.title: Refresh lane metadata when the provider selects its model and effort

findings.body: The previously deferred integration remains outstanding: fasttest.py:271 launches tests directly, while review.py:279–288 uses the separate ticket queue. Board lanes consequently cannot expose running test output/progress, and stop cannot cancel tests or end an item's worker and test together. plans/FORGE-LANES-1.md:142 assigns this integration and its command-level proofs to TESTS, so it remains advice for that task rather than an AGENTS blocker.
